physical.title: A far view of the ruins at My Son (30992152933).jpg
physical.summary: We are now close to the My Son ruins complex. After getting off the bus, you still need to walk about half a km to the ruins themselves. So one km from the gate to the bus station,  about three odd km on the bus, then half a km in- that should give you a fair idea as to how large the ruins complex is. Those are the My Son ruins in the distance. As you can see, many tourists, including the ones who left in two buses just ahead of us, are already there and are walking around. Notes about the My Son ruins appeared in one of the earlier captions, and will appear also in subsequent captions. (My Son, Central Vietnam, Nov. 2016)
